name: Workflow Canvas
summary: A dark node canvas where packets hop on the beat and one coral branch hands the anomaly to a human.
look: Deep navy canvas with a dot grid, rounded-square nodes with status rings, glowing teal bezier cables and packets, a white hub node carrying the Acme mark and a single coral exception branch.

components.name: Dot-grid canvas
components.role: deep navy with a 36 px dot grid; the camera only pans and zooms, never cuts inside a scene

components.name: Node + ports
components.role: r28 square, glyph, label below, in/out ports; max 7 nodes per frame

components.name: Status ring
components.role: grey idle · teal running · green done · coral exception — the whole story in four colours

components.name: Bezier cable + packet
components.role: glowing dot with a soft halo that hops one node per beat

components.name: Audit link
components.role: dashed teal cable: Pulse observes the pipeline without sitting in it

components.name: Exception branch
components.role: the only coral cable in the film, ending in a human decision node

motion.name: Packet hop
motion.how: packet travels one cable per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM), power1.inOut, with a 0.15 s ring pulse on arrival

motion.name: Cable snap
motion.how: dashed red → solid teal in a single frame on the drop, then path-morph to straight over 0.3 s expo.out

motion.name: Canvas camera
motion.how: pan/zoom only: 1 bar zoom-in (expo.inOut 2 s) into the node that matters; pull-back to minimap for the CTA

story: Hook: five tool nodes (dashboards, alerts, logs, chat, on-call) tangled by broken red cables around the question. Reveal: on the drop the cables snap teal into one hub — Acme Pulse — with a coral “You decide” node attached. Proof: packets flow Deploy #2231 → Checkout → Metrics (2,418 ev/s); Pulse’s dashed audit link catches Checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 and routes it down the coral branch to a Roll back node. CTA: the flow shrinks to a minimap and a cable feeds the coral Start free node.
adapt: Draw your customer’s real process as 4–6 nodes, place your product as a node or an audit link, and give the single exception path its own colour ending in a human action.

references.note: node-canvas editor conventions (ports, nodes, execution state)

fit.risk: Too many nodes turns into spaghetti; cap at 7 nodes and one exception branch.
